suggestions: I'm grateful for the pull request that merged without a single merge conflict, for once.
I'm thankful for the roti canai still warm when I get to the mamak before the rush.
I'm grateful for catching the null check I forgot before it hit staging.
I'm thankful for the sky going grey and the rain holding off until I'm already indoors.
I'm grateful for the stretch of quiet right before Fajr when the fan is the only sound in the house.
I'm thankful for the stall uncle who remembers my order without me saying it.
I'm grateful for a manager who actually reads the standup update instead of just nodding.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a job that's still here when so many friends got the call this year.
I'm grateful for my grandmother getting my name right on the first try these days.
I'm thankful for a Slack message that just says take the day off, and means it.
I'm grateful for the LRT doors opening right as I reach the platform.
I'm thankful for a bug report that turns out to be user error, not mine.
I'm grateful for leftover rendang on a Monday when cooking is the last thing I want to do.
I'm thankful for a weekend with no on-call pager and no guilt about sleeping in.
I'm grateful for my mother's voice note just checking if I've eaten, sent for no reason at all.
